scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
scripts.contract:normal: bun run build && bun test/contract/cli.ts owned production
scripts.contract:auth: bun run build && bun test/contract/cli.ts owned auth
scripts.contract:reference: bun run reference:run -- bun test/contract/cli.ts run --mode reference --target upstream --profile all
scripts.contract:roles: bun run build && bun test/contract/cli.ts owned roles && bun test/users/restart.ts
scripts.contract:roles:reference: bun run reference:run -- bun test/contract/roles.ts reference
scripts.contract:lists: bun run build && bun test/contract/cli.ts owned lists && bun test ./test/lists/restart.ts
scripts.contract:lists:reference: bun run reference:run -- bun test/contract/lists.ts reference
scripts.lists:measure: bun run build && bun test/lists/measure.ts dist/iglo.email candidate
scripts.contract:subscribers: bun run build && bun test/contract/cli.ts owned subscribers
scripts.contract:subscribers:reference: bun run reference:run -- bun test/contract/subscribers.ts reference
scripts.contract:settings: bun run build && bun test/contract/cli.ts owned settings
scripts.contract:settings:reference: bun run reference:run -- bun test/contract/settings.ts reference
scripts.contract:messaging: bun run build && bun build --compile test/messaging/stored-caller.ts --outfile dist/messaging-stored-caller && bun run reference:run -- bun test/contract/cli.ts owned messaging
scripts.contract:messaging:reference: bun run reference:run -- bun test/contract/messaging.ts reference
scripts.messaging:fixture: bun build --compile test/messaging/observe.ts --outfile dist/messaging-fixture && bun run reference:run -- dist/messaging-fixture
scripts.contract:sends: bun run build && bun test/contract/sends.ts && bun test test/sends
scripts.sends:proofs: bun build --compile test/sends/producer.ts --outfile dist/sends-producer && bun run reference:run -- bun test/sends/proofs.ts
scripts.sends:crash: bun build --compile test/sends/producer.ts --outfile dist/sends-producer && bun run reference:run -- bun test/sends/crash.ts
scripts.sends:production: bun run build && bun build --compile test/sends/producer.ts --outfile dist/sends-producer && bun run reference:run -- bun test/sends/production.ts
scripts.messaging:routing: bun build --compile test/messaging/corpus-caller.ts --outfile dist/messaging-corpus-caller && bun run reference:run -- bun test/messaging/routing.ts
scripts.messaging:corpus: bun build --compile test/messaging/corpus-caller.ts --outfile dist/messaging-corpus-caller && M21_CORPUS_HEADERS=1 bun run reference:run -- bun test/messaging/corpus.ts
scripts.contract:templates: bun run build && bun test/contract/cli.ts owned templates
scripts.contract:templates:reference: bun run reference:run -- bun test/contract/templates.ts reference
scripts.contract:tx: bun run build && bun run reference:run -- bun test/contract/cli.ts owned tx
scripts.contract:tx:reference: bun run reference:run -- bun test/contract/tx.ts reference
scripts.contract:unsubscribe: bun run build && bun run reference:run -- bun test/contract/cli.ts owned unsubscribe
scripts.scheduler:crash: bun run build && bun build --compile test/scheduler/crash-entry.ts --outfile dist/scheduler-crash && bun test/scheduler/crash.ts
scripts.contract:events: bun run build && bun test/contract/cli.ts owned events
scripts.contract:sequences: bun run build && bun test/contract/cli.ts owned sequences
